title: Yummy Aerated Valencian Quinoa Paella
description: Savory quinoa paella with a monsoon twist, featuring aromatic saffron, smoked paprika, chickery seafood, coconut cream and a hint of Turkish delight for a unique aerated finish.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water until the water runs clear.
Heat olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat and sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper until softened.
Stir in smoked paprika, saffron, and quinoa, coating everything evenly.
Add fish stock and bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered until the quinoa is tender and most liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes.
Fold in cherry tomatoes, seafood, and coconut cream, stirring gently, and cook until the seafood is just done, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pan from heat, fluff the quinoa with a fork, and then fold in the crushed Turkish delight to aerate and sweeten the dish.
Transfer the paella to a serving dish and allow it to sit for a minute to develop its airy texture.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired before serving.
